item.title: Trump's immigration ratings slide to record low as support among men falls
item.description: Public approval of US President's immigration policies has fallen to 38 percent, the lowest level since his return to the White House.

item.title: Court steps in as US immigration judge stops removal of Palestinian student
item.description: Mohsen Mahdawi, a student at Columbia University, was arrested by ICE agents last year and detained for 16 days.

item.title: Nobel Prize-winning scientist James Watson photographed with women in Epstein's house: Report
item.description: DNA pioneer Watson's presence at Epstein's New York house shows no "suggestion of wrongdoing" but appears to be from 2010s when the disgraced financier was released from jail on child-sex offence.

item.title: Artemis II moves closer to liftoff as NASA tests countdown post repairs
item.description: Four astronauts are set to journey beyond moon's far side, potentially breaking the distance record held by Apollo 13.

item.title: Israel orders land seizure in northern occupied West Bank, targeting key archaeological site
item.description: Israel's expropriation order targets land belonging to towns of Sebastia and Burqa in Nablus governorate.

item.title: 'Meaningful progress' made in Ukraine war talks: Witkoff
item.description: "President Trump's success in bringing both sides of this war together has brought about meaningful progress, and we are proud to work under his leadership to stop the killing in this terrible conflict," US envoy Steve Witkoff says.

item.title: France, Algeria revive security mechanism in bid to pull ties back from brink
item.description: High-level judicial, police and intelligence coordination resumes after months of diplomatic friction, but deeper disputes — from migration to Western Sahara — still loom over the relationship.

item.title: US, Japan announce first tranche of $550B in investments
item.description: Japan will invest $36 billion in US energy and industrial projects as the first step in its $550 billion trade deal with Washington.

item.title: Philippines' Sara Duterte declares 2028 presidential bid
item.description: Philippine vice president Duterte launches her bid for the presidency in 2028, intensifying political tensions with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. as impeachment threats grow and her father faces an ICC pre-trial.

item.title: Vatican won't participate in Trump's 'Board of Peace': top diplomat
item.description: "One concern is that at the international level, it should above all be the UN that manages these crisis situations. This is one of the points on which we have insisted," Vatican's top diplomatic official says.
